source: hand-derived G36 sequence reference from fixture topology plus CDL / Buildings .mo semantics, independent of oce-blocks; this signal follows a fixed-step discretization shared with the engine and is frame-rate dependent (see frame_rate_dependence), not an independent continuous-time re-derivation
compare_regime: exact G36 Tier-A sequence f64 trace (Value::bit_eq)
input: Economizers.Controller restricted variant: yRetDam composes common-damper return limits, enable return-damper delays, and relief-damper modulation
reference_rule: Pinned Controller.mo path: damLim return limits -> enaDis return limits -> modRel.yRetDam
diverges_from_g36_intent: embeds pinned Enable.mo (enaDis), whose Logical.Or high-limit wiring enables the economizer only while outdoor air is above the cutoff, the reverse of the block documentation and G36 section 5.16.7; outputs that depend on the enable state follow the pinned wiring, not G36 intent
frame_rate_dependence: frame-rate dependent: this signal is driven by the Controller.mo damLim minimum-OA PI loop (k=1, Ti=TiMinOA=0.5 s), integrated by forward Euler at the 60 s frame step, applied after each frame's output: xI += (k/Ti)*(e-(yU-y)/(k*Ni))*dt with dt=60 s, reset to y_reset-k*e (y_reset=0) on a rising supply-fan status. Because k*dt/Ti=120 the integrator saturates every frame and the loop output alternates between its limits, which outdoor_damper_min_limit carries into the outdoor and return damper commands. The engine uses the same forward-Euler recurrence, so this column checks that shared discretization, not an independent continuous-time derivation of Controller.mo
format: Modelica CombiTimeTable CSV (_spec/07 §9); signal CSV is time+one output; reference.csv is time+inputs+all outputs; ryu shortest-round-trip f64
